entry.title: Retro Achievement Mastery 230 - My QLDC Level

link.title: Retro Achievement Mastery 230 - My QLDC Level

entry.content:
So, I used to be big into romhacking. I got into it in the early 2000s, on a website called ACMLM’s Board, and still occasionally hack stuff to this day. My main game is Super Mario World, which is funny cause like, I don’t actually like SMW that much. I’ve made a few hacks. But the things you can do with SMW are NUTS. It’s fully open to do anything. I always say you can do anything you want in this game.

There’s a whole community for SMW hacking. It’s called Super Mario World Central, and they put on romhacking contests every few months. One such contest is QLDC, or the Questionable Level Design Contest. Originally called the Awful Level Design Contest, they decided to change it because playing intentionally bad shit is unpleasant, but playing WEIRD shit is fun. This is a contest for weird, unique ideas that might be a little strange and hard to grasp, but can still be fun.

They’re not always fun or good. But this one is. This is one of the best ones submitted ever for the contest. This is called “My QLDC Level”, and is by Faro and MM102.

So, you’ve played SMW, right? You have side scrolling levels interspersed by the world map. But what if the game… WAS the world map? Well, you can move in all the directions of the path on the world map, and we can also probably add a button for a run. But is that a game worth playing?

Turns out, yes! It goes without saying this turns SMW into a completely seperate game. It’s very unique and fun. It’s a collection of mostly single screen rooms with little puzzles and timing mechanics to move back and forth between the world map poimts and get to the end, or “the level”. There’s a level promised at the end of this, and lemme tell you, it is worth it.

In the end, this is one of the best SMW hacks. It’s quite short, there’s an achievement for beating it in seven and a half minutes. But size don’t matter. It’s a questionable, but creative little hack.

entry.title: LizstarTrek - Prodigy Season 1 Episodes 1 - 10
entry.content:
Every Sunday my Twitch subs and I watch Star Trek in my Discord. Here are my reviews and thoughts on each of the episodes as I see it. If you’re curious about a nerd’s views on Star Trek episodes, please read on, I go quite in depth with some of these episodes! I’ve watched some Star Trek before but not all of it!

This is an interesting one. Fully 3D animated, so the third animated Trek show, and Trek does quite well in animation, though it’s never been 3D. This one is ALSO… for kids! That’s not a bad thing. Some of the best shows of all time are for kids. I don’t expect this to be like, Avatar or Gravity Falls levels, but I expect this to be the real last bright spot in the Trek ouvre.

Lost and Found - PRO 7.5/10

We start by seeing Dal R’El, our hero, stuck on a prison colony. He can’t communicate with anyone else because translators were banned. He’s watched over by big scary robots, who ask him if he’s seen “fugitive zero”. He has. They are gonna torture it out of him, but then fugitive zero does a big splosion and Dal R’El tries to escape in the progress in a big exciting escape scene whiiiich ends in failure, whoopsies.

We then get the big bad robot working with some girl who communicates with a Kazon. Ooh, Delta Quadrant stuff, huh? She’s the daughter of someone important here, “The Diviner”, though seems to be just being used by him. She has to translate for them, and slave trades some cute cat creature. She’s pissed that it’s a kid, and tells off the Kazon. This gets her in kind of hot water with the superbot and her dad, though he lets her off the hook. He’s also worried about the Federation for some reason, which is interesting since they’re so fucking far away.

Dal is given a chance to escape. The “progeny”, Gweyn, will get him off this rock if he can tell her how to find “Fugitive Zero”, who is a Medusan. Medusans were in the TOS episode “Is There In Truth No Beauty?”, which is a WILD callback, that’s not even a very important episode. They’re a telepathic species that drives people mad.

There’s also lots of stuff about Dal not knowing who or what he is. Apparently that’s a point of angst for him, not knowing his species. I don’t see why that matters that much but I guess I have a different opinion on that kinda stuff.

While mining and looking for Fugitive X, Dal and a big rocky friend he makes enemies with crash into a cave and find a hidden Federation ship just… sitting there. As soon as the ship activates, they can actually communicate. The rocky friend is actually a girl, and a kid, her name is Rak-tak.

Zero shows up and now that they have a BETTER way off this rock, they’ll all work together, they just need an engineer to fix it. So they get a Tellarite Engineer named Jankom Pog. God, that cannot be his name. He’s poggers, is he?

Rok invites someone she always liked and wanted to communicate with. A cute little slug being. She wanted to know what he’s like! He is… not intelligent. That’s cute. Pet Slug! His name is Murf :3

Since Dal couldn’t find Zero (he doesn’t rat them out), he’s thrown onto the surface, which is very dangerous and no one survives who’s sent there. Gwyn is unhappy he’s sent up there but can’t do anything about it. So it’ll be super hard for him to escape right? Actually it’ll be super easy. Barely an inconvenience. Gwyn helps him escape so that he can lead them to Zero.

What results is a giant battle. They need to escape in the ship while trying to kidnap Gwyn and hold her hostage as a bargaining chip. The ship, “the protostar” as the Diviner calls it, is almost destroyed in the battle but then blasts off.

Dal has to have one last big climactic battle with the big evil robot Drednok who is TOTALLY not General Greivous. I’mma be real, getting BIG Star Wars Clone Wars vibes from this show already. That’s not a bad thing.

The day is saved by Murf pressing the phaser button. He’s a non sapient weapons specialist :D

They make it out and into space! “Okay so where are we going?” “I have no idea.” And then the ship for some reason FINALLY activates his hologram.

Hologram Janeway is here. I guess if it’s gonna be a Delta Quadrant show she should be here?

For a pilot of Trke, this is up there. Its pacing is a bit weird but hey, it’s alright!

Star Struck - PRO 6/10

Janeway gives them a crash course on what the Federation is. Everyone is super into it, but Dal is not. He thinks the Federation won’t do anything to help them, they’re just fugitives in a stolen ship anyway. I mean, the Federation is basically just the Borg, right? Anyways, now it’s THEIR ship, and Dal claims to be captain.

A few character things here. Dal lies a LOT. Rok hates lying. Gwyn wants to be a part of this but is y’know, dealing with the programming of her father.

“I appreciate a gal who knows what she likes” says Kate Mulgrew, as every woman watching this melts into a pile of goo that could rival Murf.

This kids got a lot of growing to do. I don’t like him very much yet, but I do like everyone else. Obviously he’ll get better. His stupid hard headedness makes him do stupid stuff that deactivates power. Of course, this releases Gwyn, and Rok has to go try and recapture her. We get a cool exciting fight scene where they fight in the middle of a ship as it’s being replicated. Almost like animation is a great medium for Trek!

Shit is bad and they’re about to die, so Dal gets his head out of his ass and admits he needs help. Janeway fixes everything.

Janeway gives a good speech about how the Federation didn’t come out fully formed. People need to learn to work together for a better future. It’s cute.

Also the Diviner is chasing after them in what I can only describe as a Reaper from Mass Effect. It’s like they hollowed out a Crystalline Entity and painted it black and red. It’s so amazingly obviously evil.

Dream Catcher - PRO 7/10

Janeway tells them of an M-Class planet nearby and that they need to explore it. It’s in the Hirogen system. Oh god, this is gonna end with a Hirogen skinning Murf.

They keep lying and pretending their cadets, and I think it’s kinda obvious Janeway is just humoring them. She’s a Trek hologram, she’s pretty smart.

They go out for a walk on the planet, taking the Mako. Somewhere, Picard salivates at this thing. They all IMMEDIATELY split up. This is gonna be another “we gotta learn to work together as a team” type episode. It’s honestly wild to make a show like this in Trek, where we know people die all the time from unsafe and mistakes. And they are being VERY unsafe. Obviously no children are gonna be killed, but y’know.

Gwyn breaks out and takes control of the ship EXTREMELY easily. She’s kind to Murf, which is good. Murf is our boy

We get some seperate stories. Pog finds a house and steals some soup. Rok finds some cute animals that clearly want to eat her, but she’s a rock. Zero is scanning for samples.

Dal meets some psychic root people that want him to stay so they can give him all he’d ever want. They are creepy and scary and represent themselves with Janeway. All this to eat them. Only Dal and Gwyn notice that these psychic hallucinations are real. Dal, because Janeway said she can’t leave the ship, and Gwyn because its her deepest desire. Her dad tellins her he’s proud of her, which he’d NEVER fucking do.

Gwyn tries to take off, and the Protostar crashes. She manages to escape in the shuttle, rescuing Murf, but now they’re all stranded.

Terror Firma - PRO 8.5/10

They have 10km to walk to get back to the ship, and Gwyn has injured herself, but she uses her weird metal shaping powers to make herself a cast. Dal is very cross with her. She’s OBVIOUSLY a good person and I can’t wait for this show to get past this point so she can join the crew properly. Y’know, in the same way I couldn’t wait for Catra to stop being programmed and kiss She-ra.

Especially since she’s like, the only competent one on the crew. She sets the planet on fire and they manage to escape as it tries to eat them. It had been tricking them by terraforming itself so they’d get lost. They hide in a fallen Klingon ship. Apparently the Klingons made it far out here. Dal and Gwyn have a moment together, and they decide to use the stars to navigate to the ship.

The bad guys show up, and Gwyn FINALLY betrays them to save the others.

This is some Lord of the Rings Nazgul-ass shit.

Dal leaves Gwyn behind because even if she saved them now, she’s the one who called htem here, so she “made her choice”. Aaand then the Diviner shows up, sees her dying, and is like “oh hey, sorry, but I gotta go to that ship” and goes to take the Protostar. ….Except it’s not real, it’s the fucking vines. lol fuck you buddy. The show has a good fakeout about this.

The others make it to the ship, then save Gwyn.

Dog, it was that or die, what the fuck did you expect

He tells her to “do the right thing”. She does. She engages The Protostar. Not the ship, but the protostar that’s inside the engine. They have a star inside the ship, which has a unique kind of warp, and BOOM off they go.

I liked that final scene. I think I’mma like Gwyn a lot.

Terror Firma - PRO 8/10

The proto star sent them 400 light years away. They’re safe, for now, but the proto star shuts down and they don’t know when the Diviner will be back…. so the others band together to ask Ral to go to the Federation.

RAL IS PLAYING THE GAME. JESUS CHRIST.

They go chasing after Murf for his vote, and find him in the holodeck. They discover the Koboyashi Maru in the list, and Janeway tells them it’s a test for the best Starship captains and basically eggs him into doing it. I hope this ends with him realizing he is NOT captain material, and Gwyn becomes captain instead.

Gwyn is too busy being a sadsack though. She feels she doesn’t belong anywhere. Zero talks to her and picks her up. I like Zero.

Meanwhile the Diviner makes a new Gwyn. She’s a clone of him. If Gwyn is a clone of the Diviner… does that mean she’s trans?????

The Koboyashi Maru gives them some legendary heroes. Uhura, Crusher, Odo, and Spock. Everyone but Crusher is voiced by voice lines spliced from old shows. That’s actually fantastic. Amazing solution. The episode is even dedicated to them! Anyways he fucks up bad and is given a very low rating. So he tries it again, over and over. Eventually he gets pissy and kicks Jankom off his crew to be replaced by Scotty.

Murf is a perfect creature. I would die for Murf.

It’s me.

Spock gives Dal some advice through spliced voice lines, and it’s cute.

Meanwhile, they hack the Protostar and get some of the old hidden files. they find…

THE RETURN OF CHOKIE.

First Con-tact - PRO 7/10

They discover the transporter and do tests with it. They need a living test subject, and teleport Murf. MURF, NO!! They’re gonna fucking inside-out Murf. No, he’s just sliding down the front of the ship. What a cold open.

They get a distress call from a poor old crone who’s ship is on fire and needs people to save the orphans. Dal recognizes her as the Ferengi who raised him. They go to visit, she’s so happy to see him. She’s like “I’ve been looking for you for years!” she’s also… VERY obviously untrustworthy. She totally sold him to slavery. She needs some things from a pre-space civilization, and she’ll give them a cloaking device they need to hide.

So it’s time for the “let’s learn about the prime directive” episode!

Ah, there it is.

They successfully make first contact, with Gwyn discovering how htey communicate through resonance. She should be captain, she’s the only person here captable except for Zero, and I don’t think they’d want it.

It’s a species you’d see in Metroid Prime :o

Anyways the aliens gift them… a song :) It’s beautiful and all the crew like it. But the Ferengi is like “fuck that that’s not what I want” and steals their crystals.

Anyways yes, obviously she’s evil and sold him into slavery. She also steals stuff from their ship and leaves in her cloaked ship. With some trickery, they get the crystal back, but obviously they fucked up in many ways. Janeway is NOT happy. They lost supplies, they did seriouis harm to the development of this species, and Dal is real depressed cause his mommy is evil ): Gwyn can relate.

First Con-tact - PRO 7/10

Janeway needs to try and get them together, so she makes a wheat/chicken/fox puzzle, aaand it goes poorly too. Dal freaks out and comes clean about how they stole the ship and aren’t a real crew.

Meanwhile, now that they learn where the ship is, the Diviner hacks their systems to create a robot to hunt them.

A Tachyon storm causes a temporal blast, which seems to rip Janeway into multiple pieces. They all appear to be in seperate timelines or universes of some kind. Jankom’s explodes and he dies. rip.

Janeway finds herself in another temporal phase with Rok, and figures out what’s going on. Everyone IS on the same ship, but is just in a different temporal phase. For Rok, it’s going very slow. For Jankom, is moved VERY fast. Janeway tries to get Rok to stop the warpcore breach, but she panics and turns her off. At least Zero is ACTUALLY competent and fixes the problem, giving the solution to Janeway so she can pass it to the next person. Whoever the next person is will have to save us all- oh it’s Murf. Fuck. It’s okay Murf, we don’t blame you.

It’s Dal’s time, but he’s still a sad sack. Janeway gives him a pep talk about Apollo 13. Cute. He still fails, but at least his failure will pave the way for learning how to fix it in the future.

Dreadnok is fully built on the ship in Gwyn’s time, and fucking deletes Holo Janeway. He uses Chakotay’s command codes. Of COURSE he didn’t voice lock them. Gwyn blows him out of the airlock, but that blows out the thing they were using the fix the engines aaaand it blows up, too.

They have one last hope. Rok is still alive! She gets a message from Gwyn’s time, about how they all bnelieve in her, and not to doubt herself. She rebuilds the coupler, and also rebuilds Janeway while she’s at it. Thankfully time is moving so slow. Very slow. Very, very VERY slow. She was in there for… “too long”. She studied a lot.

Then we get a fun cliffhanger… Drednok is still out there! Dun dun dunnnn.

A Moral Star Part 1 - PRO 7/10

Drednok’s remains deliver an ultimatum: If they do not return the Protostar, he’s going to kill all of his slaves. They can either go back to the prison and TRY to save them, probably fail, or possibly trust the Diviner which they totally cannot. Orrr jump to the Federation, hoping they can jump fast enough to save them, but probably not.

Everyone is down to go except Dal. He’s scared. He doesn’t trust that he can do this correctly, but he has his friends to help prepare plans. We get a cute montage of them working together to come up with a plan.

They get cadet uniforms and blast off. As Janeway says, they are doing a dangerous mission and risking themselves to save others. They’ve earned Starfleet. It’s a cute moment.

They are tractor beam’d in, but they have a plan. It goes a little out the window as the terms change and he demands Gwyn too. Of course, she sacrifices herself for the others “to make it right” for not doing anything to help them sooner.

GOTH MOMMY JANEWAY.

Surprise, a guy who does child slave trading betrays them and blows up their engines, killing their power, gravity, and eventually oxygen.

lol it’s all been a trap. They knew it’d go like this. Zero was actually Murf in a fake Zero, and Murf is fucking EATING the protostar. MURF ATE A STAR. I love you Murf.

They just hope they have time to do the rest of their plan.

A Moral Star Part 2 - PRO 8.5/10

The miners can now talk. Two of them are gay. I was gonna make a joke about them but then they just fucking did it. They out-joked me!!!

Rok and Jankom are trying to fix the ship, while Zero and Dal are trying to get all the miners ready to get on the ship and escape. They turn everyone’s ankle bracelets into translators.

The miners rebel and immediately kill Drednok, the cat child fucking decapitates him. But not before he transmits Murf’s coordinates and the protocore is transported. You’d tihnk he could just scan for the massive energy signature but maybe Murf dampens it.

We then get a sickass scene where, turns out goth mommy Janeway was upgraded to resist the overrides, and fucking beats the shit out of the Diviner. Unfortunately, the Diviner convinces Gwyn to stop by saying he’ll “tell her the truth”. I don’t care WHAT he’s doing, even if it’s “saving our people”, child slavery kills every possible chance at you being a good guy.

He shows her a holodeck program of what happens to their home planet. Currently, it’s fine. He was sent back in time to stop them. According to him, Starfleet did this. First contact caused a civil war and they all killed each other. So his plan is to go to Starfleet and kill them all. He set up a bomb on the ship to blow up if they ever go to Starfleet. You’d think there’d be a few other options, but nope. Genocide. Thankfully Gwyn realizes how fucking shitty this is immediately.

This is a good line.

Dal beams onboard the ship to try and save Gwyn, buuuut immediately fails. Good thing Zero is also there to…. do this.

The Diviner used Zero as a weapon to drive others mad. Now it’s his turn. He’s stopped, but not before Gwyn sees Zero in the reflection of his combadge. She’s mad ): That’s sad.

They banish the Diviner to the jail planet. So uh, he’s dead, right? He’s insane and stuck on a planet by himself, he’s fucked. That’s just killing him.

With a little bit of medicine, she’s fixed, but forgets the events of what happened. That sucks, cause now she forgot about the bomb. Gwyn is a little apprehensive of heading to Starfleet, but off they go, with a little cute monologue by Janeway.

Their signature is picked up. Janeway is on her way.

This isn’t the end of the season, but like, it had a mini-hiatus and is very season finale feeling.

Over all? Very good! Good characters and plot. The animation feels like a Gamecube game sometimes but thats fine. Thats almost a GOOD thing to me. Excited for more!

entry.title: X-Men Deep Dive Readalong 3 - Issues 41 - 45
entry.content:
I’m reading every X-Men comic. This was a mistake. This will continue to be a mistake. But when have mistakes ever stopped me? Come hang out for some reviews of mid-tier 60s comics!

X-Men #41 - February 1968 3/10

This is a weird one. The X-Men are on a train that’s suddenly attacked by a weird lookin’ hulkin’ guy. They fight him but he easily shrugs off all their attacks, because that’s always how this comic works, the X-Men just get the shit kicked out of them constantly. They name this guy and he happily takes that as his new name.

He is “Grotesk the sub-human”, a prince of some ancient civilization that lived in caves below the surface. Everyone he loves died and he got mutated by I THINK atomic blasts from above? And now he wants revenge. Honestly, I’m on this guy’s side??

Actually he apparently wants nukes so he can blow up the Earth entirely. I dunno, that feels like going a LITTLE far. The X-Men show up again to stop him, aaaaand to be continued

We’re still doing really short issues causae we have the mini stories in the back. This one has Jack o’Diamonds, who met Scott and went “Hey you’re my minion now”, demanding Scott murder Xavier. Scott’s like “what the fuck? No?” so Jack goes and pushes himself into some radiation machine which turns him into pure diamond, and he calls himself The Living Diamond. This guy’s got like three names!

X-Men #42 - March 1968 3/10

This is such a funny cover. Anyways WOAH, SENSATIONALISM, PROFESSOR X IS GONNA DIE FOR THE FIRST TIME FOR REAL HE’S REALLY GONNA DIE HE’S GONNA DIE OMG HE’S GONNA DIE WOW

Anyways Xavier is being kinda weird. Scott and Beast are fighting Grotesk and getting his ass kicked and Xavier is refusing to let the rest of them go help. Jean is siding with him, everyone else is like “what the hell???”

Scott and Beast, of course, get beat up by Grotesk, who just… leaves.

Everyone wants to confront Xavier for being a dickhead, and Jean is holding them back. Did I mention the weird costume change btw? I dunno if I like it much. but then Xavier is like “actually no please help me” because he’s being murdered by Grotesk for some reason. Xavier led him there to try and lay a trap but uh, told no one about this.

They manage to defeat Grotesk, or really Xavier does, (actually the machine he’s trying to steal blows up and kills him) and then he admits that he was actually dying of a completely different disease, but set this all up to stop Grotesk. And then he just, dies.

Or so he claims. You already did this in like, issue 4, can I really trust you??

More backstory, Living Diamond is attacking Xavier now, and Scott sides with him cause he’s not a raging murderer made out of actual diamonds.

They use a radiation machine to make him EVEN MORE diamond, but he’s already pure diamond, so he just fucking explodes. Scott just killed a man. Scott then joins Xavier as his first X-Man and gets his outfit and visor.

X-Men #43 - April 1968 3.5/10

Another incredible Magneto face.

Magnetos back I guess. Apparently this happened in some other comics, maybe Avengers?

Quicksilver attends Xavier’s funeral, and everyone is bothered by it, because they hate him again. Apaprently Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch denounced humanity and joined with Magneto again? Man, they just… cannot make good decisions. He runs away.

Xavier left them a VHS tape with his last will, and it’s basically “yo, Magneto is back, take him out”.

….Man the incest vibes are REAL rough with these two. Anyways Scarlet Witch seems to be sick, her powers are gone, and Pietro WANTED to get Xavier to cure her, but now he’s dead, soooo. He calls Xavier “our only friend”, which is fucking wild, they were never on the same side or even really interracted. Anyways Magneto is claiming to create a device to cure Wanda but obviously he won’t, but they gotta stick around just incase.

Magneto steals a boat, and the X-Men show up aaaand get their asses kicked. To be continued???

Our bonus this issue is about Scott. Again. It’s about his powers, and goes into more depth. Apparently they are solar powered (I cannot WAIT for the punch dimension). It explains how he uses his visor without touching it (button in his glove), etc etc. It’s alright.

X-Men #44 - May 1968 4/10

Angel centric issue this time.

The X-Men are captured by Magneto, who continues to not kill anyone cause that’d be mean. Angel manages to break out and has to flee and look for help. Quicksilver, who can fly I guess, chases after but fails to catch him in time, somehow.

Angel goes off into the ocean and into a storm, as an island forms out of the ocean. He explores the ocean and finds some red flying guy who attacks Angel

This guy is Red Raven. They fight for a page before Raven goes “wait, why am I doing this I don’t want to hurt you” and stops. He explains he just wants to stop people from finding this island. Years ago, his people lived here, and they were going to invade the planet and conquer the Humans, but he was like “that’s rude >:(“ and gasses them all and puts them in cryo tubes. Now he must keep watch, as they will awake every 20 years as the island rises above the surface. Angel is like “hey isn’t it kinda bad to betray all your people?” “Maybe you’re right… ah, no, you’re not, bye” and then Raven kicks Angel out and the island sinks. The end.

This feels like a filler episode but it wasn’t… bad?

We get Bobby Backstory this time! Bobby is out with his girlfriend when those Roving Gangs Of Bullies that always exist in comics like this attack him and try to assault her. He freezes them, and then everyone is like “Holy shit, someone to be racist towards!” and hate him for ANOTHER reason now. Also his girlfriend says he’s a freak and runs away.

A mob comes and drags him away for using powers on someone, and not actually hurting them. Oh… no? Really they just want to be bigots. The comic is going harder into this now. Gosh, when did the X-Men get woke- oh wait. Anyways, Xavier and Scott read the news and go to save him, to be continued

X-Men #45 - June 1968 4.5/10

Angel continues to try and go get help, specifically the Avengers, as Cyclops manages to burst out of his jail. He finds Jean who’s unconscious and is like “welp she’s useless”, wandering around as he bumbles into, first Toad and secondly Quicksilver. Quicksilver is a weirdly complicated character for this era, as a villain who has no actual interest in doing evil things, and is like “hey we don’t gotta fight” but Cyclops punches at him anyway cause fuck you, Quicksilver!

Quicksilver thinks all mutants should be allied together to fight against the Homosapien menace. Man, THIS is where all that came from??? This is wild, this is Magneto’s whole fucking thing in the X-Men media I’ve actually seen. In this, Magneto couldn’t care less, he just wants to rule over other people. It’s actually really interesting the path this concept takes. It goes from being the character trait of a sympathetic anti-villain to the character trait of a straight up villain (Magneto) to the character trait of a sympathetic anti-villain (Magneto, again, but written better).

Anyways Cyclops knocks out Quicksilver and is worried he actually hurt him, wheeen the Avenger show up, see Cyclops beating up their friend, and turn on him. Ohhh boy, MORE OF MY FAVORITE, FORCED REASONS FOR HEROES TO FIGHT…. and it’s not even in the next X-Men issue!!! Weird. It’s actually in Avengers #53.

In the backstory, Cyclops comes to break Bobby out of jail, but he’s like “No, I trust the system to give me a fair trial” as the hicks outside his jail cell go “ohhh boy, can’t wait to do a good ol’ fashioned lynchin’!”

Cyclops tries to FORCE him to leave, which just makes shit look worse. Now they’re like “oh I guess now we’re JUSTIFIED in killing them”. Bobby beats up Cyclops as the mob turns on both of them.

Avengers #53 - June 1968 2.5/10

We’re doin’ this again. The Avengers see their friend being attacked by Cyclops, ignore the fact that Quicksilver literally denounced Humanity openly and is working with a villain very obviously, we need a reason to fight so we fight.

Cyclops thinks they might be… robots?? Okay, sure. We’re got Hawkeye, Goliath, Wasp, and the recently introduced Black Panther. They all gang up on Cyclops, who somehow holds them off even though he gets his ass kicked by villains of the week all the time and he JUST fought Quicksilver AND broke out of his bindings. Dude should be spent.

Angel shows back up and they start to split off. Meanwhile Megneto and his cronies watch happily, cause this is perfectly fine. Eventually of course they realize that this is all bullshit and fight Magneto instead. Toad betrays Magneto, sick of his bullshit, and sets the base to explode as he, Scarlet Witch, and Quicksilver dip. Once again, Magneto is defeated by his own Assholish behavior.

Magneto is blown up and seemingly dies. Quicksilver and Wanda don’t even talk to the Avengers ONCE in this. What the fuck?
entry.summary: I’m reading every X-Men comic. This was a mistake. This will continue to be a mistake. But when have mistakes ever stopped me? Come hang out for some reviews of mid-tier 60s comics!

entry.title: LizstarTrek - Discovery Season 4 episodes 9 -
entry.content:
Every Sunday my Twitch subs and I watch Star Trek in my Discord. Here are my reviews and thoughts on each of the episodes as I see it. If you’re curious about a nerd’s views on Star Trek episodes, please read on, I go quite in depth with some of these episodes! I’ve watched some Star Trek before but not all of it!

I know literally nothing about Discovery, except for The Burn, and that it leads into Strange New Worlds. So uh… I’ve been dreading this one. But hey, who knows! Maybe it’ll surprise me!!

It has not so far. Y’all ready to see Michael save the universe again???

The Examples - DIS 1.5/10

Michael STILL is trying to get her war criminal boyfriend to stop doing warcrimes and sends him a message about how the DMA is just accidental collatoral damage. He’s like “Nope. Don’t care, off to do warcrimes, I still love you by the way <3” fire this man into the sun??

Anyways Commander Nhan is back to help out. I do love how this show keeps writing out characters and then bringing them back a few episodes later. Wait did I say like? I find it kinda stupid. Why can’t they write out the BAD characters… or well, character. Just Michael.

They keep doing stuff with Saru and the Vulcan president. It’s actually kinda cute. More of that, please.

“Lots of people agree with Book…” Lots of people are saying this. Many online are saying Genocide Good actually. If that’s you, keep that to your fucking self and get out of starfleet, dude. I’d be on the bridge, raising my hand, and going “actually genocide is bad actually and I think we should be doing more to stop Book instead of being halfassed about this?? Also Saru should be in charge.”

They send a shuttle to try and sneak to Book’s ship, and of course Warcrime Scientist is like “oh I set up an autonomous defense grid of nanomachines :)” and they’re KILLING a bunch of Discovery’s crew. Book’s like “UM, YOU DID THAT WITHOUT TELLING ME ALSO STOP KILLING MY FRIENDS?” oh, so NOW you care. Afterward they barely get them out Michael immediately calls him and he’s standoffish and doesn’t care again. I already know this is gonna end with Book back with the good guys but frankly I can’t stand that idea, he’s kinda ruined for me.

Michael has been TRYING to stay out of this because of her conflict of interest, but steps in and does some gambit to get ahead of Book in his race to do genocide.

I forget if I mentioned it but this scientist asshole reminds me of Elon Musk, he is immensely unlikable.

Nahn and this guy take on basically the same exact role on each other’s respective ships. “Why are you not KILLING these people already???” Michael eventually gets sick of this shit and literally goes “this isn’t black and white, there’s a middle ground here, and I can get Book to see it.” YOU HAVE BEEN TRYING FOR THE PAST THREE EPISODES AND FAILING. You literally gave an ultimatum last episode!!!!

Michael goes ALONE to talk to Book about this, and gives him the middle ground. Based on recent data, the DMA will not be in an area with any casualties for a week. Give us a week to make first contact, at least. Book agrees. Of COURSE Michael saying the same thing over and over eventually wins. Tarka of course just… releases the weapon anyway. BTW of course Tarka’s plan to use the power source here to power his way back to his universe fails, so this was all done for nothing.

Everyone fucking fails. The end.

…And then Saru goes to Culber and is like “so it seems the president is interested in me and asked me to dinner. What the fuck do I do”. DUDE. WE JUST DECLARED WAR ON GOD ALIENS. I actually LIKE this plotline but this is not the time??? Culber calls him an idiot.

Then they see that another DMA appeared in the exact same place and Michael goes “It seems…. we just made first contact…” like it’s a deep line. This shit sucked.

The Galactic Barrier - DIS 2/10

Everyone is recovering and needs a new plan. Basically, the Federation has to rush to make it outside the Galactic Barrier so they can make first contact, and Book needs to make it through the Galactic Barrier so he can kill them at THEIR home instead. Book and Tarka are on very unfriendly terms right now after the last episode.

Adira is back, helping them find a way through the barrier. You know, a thing no one is known to have EVER done. The barrier is a weird Trek thing btw, but it’s been there since season 2 of TOS.

We learn some more Tarka backstory, which is wild cause I care about this guy less than the fucking Xindi scientist from season 3 of Enterprise, and that guy was dumb as hell. Basically he was in an Emerald Chain prison with another scientist, who was secretly building a dimensional teleporter to take him to the heaven of his people, which he beleived was an alternate universe. So now that’s where Tarka wants to go, to be with his boyfriend.

Zora has basically stopped being a character out of nowhere and they just go “the computer” again.

Ticking clock time, the DMA is now targetting Earth and Vulcan. Gee, maybe blowing up their shit was A Bad Idea. And then Michael’s like “I NEED TO TELL EVERYONE ON BOARD THAT AS WE GO OUT OF THE GALAXY THEIR FAMILY MIGHT BE DYING” dude no, that is a Very Bad Idea.

They make it through the galactic barrier, yaaay, of course this crew would be the one to finally make it out. Just that easy. Anyways this episode ends with yet another Michael oneliner cause they gotta make her seem cool. They are failing.

Rosetta - DIS 2/10

They arrive at a planet that used to be the home planet of the DMA aliens. It was apparently at one point a gas giant but then the gas disappeared and now it’s a rocky planet. Thats not how that works. Everyone walks slowmo down the hallway cause again they are trying to make this cool. They are failing.

Also Book and Tarka are just here now. IT REALLY WAS JUST THAT EASY.

Also why are we sending both the captain and the XO? Even the fucking president calls this out. She’s right. But Michael says something that is barely related and she’s like “oh I see, understood”. Michael is always correct. The leader of Earth ALSO goes “why are we going to these aliens’ old home planet instead of just talking to them? My planet might be about to explode.” and Michael goes “I hear you.” with an implied “but I don’t give a fuck what you think” after that.

As soon as they reach the surface, Saru starts freaking the hell out, using his super senses to sense something horrible. Um…. that was removed? He doesn’t have that anymore? That happened like, in season 2.

It’s delayed, but it eventually effects everyone else too. Except Detmer, for some reason. I think this is the first time Detmer is even out on an away mission. We then get a scene with Adina going “I wish I could be more like Detmer. Confident, able to go on away missions…” WE’VE NEVER SEEN HER DO ANY OF THAT.

We also get Book and Tarka sneaking onboard the ship. They’re trying to sneak to talk to the Earth Leader cause she’s also interested in stopping the aliens at any cost so maybe she can help us do warcrimes!! Also what the fuck? They’re just sneaking around, once people leave they skulk out. Do we not have any… scanners? Sensors? Security cameras??? I know we LITERALLY do not have a security officer, she left the show and they never replaced her.

Book talks to the Earth Leader and she goes “You have to promise to let us try diplomacy first, and if that doesn’t work, then I’ll back you doing warcrimes”. “You have my word.” THAT DIDN’T WORK LAST TIME, WHY THE FUCK DO WE BELIEVE FOR A SECOND TARKA WILL ALLOW THIS THIS time

We are getting Detmer backstory and character. This happens so extremely infrequently… she’s LITERALLY been here since episode one. She’s in 50 episodes out 65. And we are FINALLY learning ANYTHING about her at ALL. Anyways they learn that the aliens are scared and anxious, and had their home destroyed at one point, so mayb ethat’s a way to communicate? Fair enough. They also discover these chemicals they use to communicate, kinda like pheromones, so let’s use that to talk to them.

The story ends with a dun dun, Tarka kidnapped Reno and is holding her hostage. She’s nonplussed about it because she’s the best character in this show. God I wish she had more to do.

Species C-10 - DIS 3/10

Everyone is preparing for first content. Did no one realize Jett Reno has disappeared? She’s very loud, and has her fingers in everything, she’s pretty unignorable. She quickly gets to work trying to get Book to realize he’s being an idiot, but Book is an idiot so he ignores her.

They go to see the C-10, and are immediately attacked and dragged into the bubble. The Earth despot is like “welp, we failed. A soldier needs to realize when they’ve hit a wall, time to change tactics.” WE ARE NOT SOLDIERS. WE ARE STAR FLEET.

We don’t get to SEE the alien but we see its shape in the cloud. It spits out some complex pheromones showing 6 different emotions. It also blinks some lights at them. It’s trying to communicate! They spent like 2 minutes trying to explain that to me, when Spock woulda explained it in two sentences, but that’s fine.

Uuuunfortunately, the despot of Earth is like “welp, we can’t just talk to them normally and it’ll take time, so it’s time to kill.”

I hate all of these people. They are so stupid. At least we have Jett Reno who goes from “you’re hurting so you’re blind.” to “YOU ARE GOING TO FUCKING KILL US ALL. LOOK AT THE GOD DAMN MATH”.

Normally I’d love this episode. They’re trying to sus out a language so they can communicate with an alien which is threatening them, possibly without realizing it. That is so Trek. It’s so Trek and could be so good. BUT THE WRITING IS BORING AND BAD AND WE HAVE ALL THIS EXTRA SHIT TO ADD A CLOCK ON TOP.

Okay so NOW Book says “I won’t do to the 10-C what they did to Kweijan”. NOW YOU’RE AGAINST GENOCIDE?! YOU’VE BEEN FOR IT FOR FOUR EPISODES. You’re only upset cause now it might actually hurt Discovery too, you fucking idiot. Anyways OBVIOUSLY the omnicidal gay Elon Musk betrays him so he can kill everyone cause he doesn’t actually care about anyone but his boyfriend.

Communication is going well as they send a breathable atmosphere bubble covered in peacefulness. But since Tarka is gonna fuck it all up I can’t be as invested in this cause it’s all gonna go to shit before they fix it further.

The president, president of Nivar, Saru, and of course Michael go into the bubble and it’s a replica of the Discovery bridge. Eh, why bother building a set? Also why is Saru here? They have a linguist who’s been doing ALL of the progress in this episode.

They do, in fact, communicate “you are hurting us” and they go “oh fuck we didn’t mean to, we’re sorry” aaaaand then of course Tarka starts killing them. At least Reno gets a message out of “FUCKING BLOW US UP.”

Coming Home - DIS 2/10

Assuming someone betrayed them, they start go and start asking around and immediately find out it was the fascist Earth despot who is like “I did it cause Booker told me it’d be fine and you were gone for 5 seconds, I got scared!” “BOOKER IS HOSTAGE AND YOU WERE LIED TO. COMMUNICATION WAS WORKING. YOU JUST KILLED EVERYONE.” “Whoops. My bad :) Pobody’s nerfect!”

Shoot every fascist into the sun.

The Nivarian president mind melds with the 10-C through a WINDOW, AND THE VACUUM OF SPACE. SHE COULD JUST DO THAT?! Maybe you shoulda done that earlier?! She explains after this, while in the sick bay cause it knocked her on her ass, that they’re a hive mind, confused and scared, and we’re running out of time to explain that those are not with us and we need to stop Booker’s ship.

Book manages to break him and Reno out and then sends Reno to Discovery as he tries to take back over his ship. Reno delivers the message that he loves Michael. That makes all of it worth it. :)

Also it looks like in order to win we’ll need the fascist’s help after all, I hate that. Oh apaprently she’s NOT the leader of earth, just like, their head general? Either way, her vibes are Bad. At least she’s gonna go do a suicide mission to try and stop them. “I’m with you captain, all the way.” - someone who gave up after they disappeared for 5 seconds earlier.

Book FINALLY gets through to Tarka who does a complete 180 when Book just flat out says “would your boyfriend want you to do galactic suicide”. That’s what it takes. He ends up sacrificing himself to stop it. And MAYBE his teleporter will send him to the afterlife with his boyfriend, who knows. The show tries to do this thing where it’s all sad about him doing this. Look, I don’t care HOW gay he is, genocide is decidedly ungroovy.

Wow, an ACTUALLY kinda good scene! The admiral and Tilly are staying behind on the Federation HQ as it’s exploding from the gravitational waves of the DMA, they stayed behind to evacuate as many as they could. They have a drink of Whisky as they talk about having few regrets. It’s good! Also Admiral Vance continues to be the only good admiral.

They try to communicate once again with the 10-c. They are, at least, kinda cool.

It’s so close to being good and Trekian buuuuut it’s so filled with stuff I don’t care about at all. Namely the stuff with Book and Tarka. They think Book might be dead btw, he’s missing, and Michael starts crying durring communications. Again, like one of the three emotions she’s allowed to show. She LITERALLY PIKACHU TEARS HIM BACK TO LIFE, because they see how sad she is and just RECONSTITUTES HIM BACK FROM HIS ATOMS AFTER HE WAS BLOWN TO FUCK.

THIS IS SO STUPID.

A major theme of this season was Michael learning to deal with loss AND YOU DIDN’T EVEN COMMIT TO THAT.

…Apparently they just intercepted his transporter signal and was holding him because they assumed it was important, but it’s still just, so dumb.

Book tells them that they don’t NEED the wall keeping them safe that they power with Boronite and they’re like “oh I see our bad” and they stop! That’s it! Success, victory, we win, Book and Michael are happy and we’ll just ignore the fact that Book was going to do a genocide until he wasn’t because he stopped in time.

At least Saru and the Nivarian President are hooking up now. They’re cute. AND uncensored handholding!

The Federation president says “I said you weren’t ready for a Voyager captaincy, but you are now”. I love hearing about character growth rather than seeing it :) And she also kind of commutes Book’s sentencing because “reasons matter”. Um, not when it comes to attempted genocide. He’s just gonna do community service.

Aaaand the season ends with more Michael Slam Poetry.

I hated this. This was the worst Trek season, I think, out of all of them. Yes, even Enterprise season 3 or Picard season 1. Really, really bad. In a different way. It’s not offensive, it’s just very bad and boring. Those seasons are at least fun to complain about, I had SOME enjoyment ranting about them. I didn’t even feel any enjoyment ranting about this. I just didn’t care. There was a SINGLE episode above… 3/10 I think???? Which is fucking BAD.

entry.title: LizstarTrek - Discovery Season 4 episodes 5 - 8
entry.content:
Every Sunday my Twitch subs and I watch Star Trek in my Discord. Here are my reviews and thoughts on each of the episodes as I see it. If you’re curious about a nerd’s views on Star Trek episodes, please read on, I go quite in depth with some of these episodes! I’ve watched some Star Trek before but not all of it!

I know literally nothing about Discovery, except for The Burn, and that it leads into Strange New Worlds. So uh… I’ve been dreading this one. But hey, who knows! Maybe it’ll surprise me!!

It has not so far. Y’all ready to see Michael save the universe again???

The Examples - DIS 2.5/10

This title sounds like a TV show about super heroes from the 2000s. It has “Smallville” energy.

Michael posits that because there’s no historical record in the Sphere Data of the DMA anomaly having happened before, it’s not natural, and thus is manmade. Everyone is like “WOAH TRUTH BOMB” as if somehow no one thought of that possibility yet.

They need to evacuate a planet, which they’ll do in 4 hours, no problems. Hey, remember when the Federation failed at an evacuation of Romulus and they had WEEKS? Anyway. Oh apparently it’s not a planet, it’s a bunch of chained together asteroids. Kind of a neat set piece. Is this a left over thing from the Halo TV show??

The magistrate is like “oh goodie, come save us. Oh, those 6 isolated signatures? Those are the prisoners in our jails. We just left them there to die :)” holy shit fuck them what the hell. Now they have to bust in and save them and get out before the DMA hits. Pumpkin describes this as “a tabletop adventure”. Hey I don’t think the captain should be the one who- okay.

Also Michael keeps announcing everything to her crew over the intercom? And Culber literally goes “everyone is a little on edge about it all” YEAH THAT’S WHY YOU KEEP SOME THINGS SECRET WHEN YOU’RE IN CHARGE

They bring a commander with them, one of the ones on the bridge, Rhys I think??? He starts talking about his life and oh god I’m getting flash backs to Airaim, they’re just gonna kill him aren’t they

Some Risian scientist is here to help them figure out what the DMA is and he’s like, OVERLY an asshole, like very clearly. Y’all gotta at least make it have SOME level of suspense, y’know.

The prisoners are like “WE WANT A GUARANTEE THAT WE’LL BE RELEASED IF WE GO WITH YOU” “I mean, we’ll work with diplomats to-“ “A GUARANTEE, NOW, OR WE DON’T GO” then you fucking die, dude. What do you want???

Michael is the worst captain ohhhh my god, how did she not know the process of asylum

The asshole scientist forces them to do some dangerous experiment that uses a lot of extra power. While the evacuation is happening right now. They’re transporting people onto the ship and destabalizing shit at the same time. Dude, just wait AN HOUR. OR A DAY. WHY DO YOU NEED TO DO THIS RIGHT THE FUCK NOW? They get angry at STAMETS of all people for enabling this guy to do this.

One of the prisoners refuses to go with them, not cause of any weird bullshit from earlier but instead it was like… he feels such guilt over killing someone and thinks he should just die. He killed someone and stole a girl’s future, in order to survive because he had nothing cause he was in a slave trader’s empire. Like, okay, I’m not gonna say he SHOULD have killed people? But I will say uh, he doesn’t need to just sit there and let himself die. That helps literally no one and he’s CLEARLY repentant of his crimes??

The episode ends with Michael returning a holographic family tree the prisoner stole, and somehow kept hidden while in jail for 30 years

Stormy Weather - DIS 3.5/10

They’re still occasionally talking about Zora being a sapient AI and that it’s kinda weird, but is it… really that weird??

Anyways they’re scanning a subspace rift caused by the DMA and then get sucked into it. They’re now in like, an energy-less zone. No scans, no data, nothing. Drones they send out disintigrate, so clearly something is bad.

Michael caves literally 4 minutes after going “ALRIGHT, WE’RE GOING TO RISK OUR LIVES TO GET ANSWERS TO SAVE OTHERS”. “Okay, that’s it, this is scary, reverse course”. Then they find out they can’t leave. This is literally just “The Immunity Syndrome” from TOS. It’s like, the same thing. There’s nothing WRONG with doing the same topic or concept again, but I don’t trust them to do it better than that episode, and that episode wasn’t even like, amzing.

They try to go to warp with Book guiding the warp, aaand it just blows the fuck up on him. Now he’s seeing his dead dad being a dickhead to him. His dad has a weird cadence in the way he speaks, it almost screams John de Lancie.

We get some ACTUALLY good scenes between and Gray. Stuff about gender, identity, and self. Unfortunately this is kinda… dropped out of nowhere, because suddenly things are breaking down the ship on the outside.

They use Sonar to determine the way to get out of the void, but their shields are going to break down and life support will fail before they get there. So Michael determines a way to keep them all alive. Just… put them all in the pattern buffer. Man, Trek loved doing that around this time huh

Book has some talk with his Ghost Dad where he’s like “all those I lost aren’t gone, not really, they live on through me” and then Michael has a weird slow mo walk through the sparking breaking ship. She’s in a pressure suit and trying to help get Zora through it. The AI is having a panic attack at having to save everyone. Maybe it’s a bad idea to have sapient ship AI actually. You know, ship AI is a thing that I WANT Trek to explore cause I really like it as a concept and there’s some really cool stuff you can do with it, but I do not trust modern Trek to handle it well enough.

Michael is burning up. Why is she here? Why does she HAVE to be here? Like yes, the computer needs someone to hold her hand, but no one can have a character moment without Michael, huh??? Not even the fucking computer.

Anyways, they make it out, the end. What good did this do? Well, it determines that whatever force is doing this is from outside the galaxy. We haven’t had much intergalactic lore in Trek, actually. Off the top of my head it’s… the aliens from Conspiracy, and the Kelvans from “By Any Other Name” in TOS. I think thats it?? So like, interesting space to explore in tbh. I just don’t expect them to do it in an interesting way.

This is the least I’ve cared about Star Trek.

Stormy Weather - DIS 3.5/10

They call the species they’re trying to find “Species 10-C”. Zora uses the data they gathered to determine where this species is. She also decides that if they know where the data is, they’ll go and get themselves killed, so she refuses to give them the coordinates. Well then. This also makes Starfleet look at them and go “hey, you shouldn’t have a sentient ship, that is Bad”.

While they’re trying to figure that out, they also visit for a symposium on the DMA. We meet some Earth representatives, who now also reincorporated Titan into their jurisdiction, “inspired by Michael’s methods”. Of course they were.

Cronenberg has a meeting with Saru that everyone just starts randomly crashing, to talk about Zora. First Stamets crashes it like “SHE SCARES ME, WE NEED TO DO SOMETHING SO SHE DOESN’T FREAK OUT AND KILL EVERYONE” then Gray comes in like “WE CAN’T LET THEM KILL HER” and Cronenberg is like “what the fuck everyone I was just going to put her in another body of her choice so she doesn’t have power over so many people”. And then Zora just… makes a fucking kill switch and gives it to them?? Instead??? Actually I liked Cronenberg’s plan Zora, we can just do that one?

Ruon Tarka, the Risan scientist from that other episode who was a weird asshole, hijacks the symposium and goes “Hey, I made a super weapon to kill the aliens who are in control of this anomaly ;D Let’s do a genocide <3” And everyone is like “Hell yea let’s do that” while Michael goes “NO YOU CAN’T JUST KILL PEOPLE”. I mean, the super weapon he’s suggesting is an Isolytic weapon, something banned for literally 800 fucking years, because it highly damages subspace. It’s the Trek equivelent of nuclear weapons, you do not use them.

This is the first season of Discovery. This is literally just the plot of season 1 of discovery.

Tarka enlists Book’s help in convincing them to let him nuke reality, and tells him he’s from another reality or something? And that… convinces book??? I’mma be real I’m super checked out. Anyways I think Book basically betrays Michael by going “yeah let ‘em burn”

They decide that Zora isn’t actually AI, she’s “an entirely new form of life”. It’s kind of them TRYING to do a Measure of a Man and failing.

Then we get Michael doing one of her fucking weepy eyed speeches to change everyone’s mind. Except it’s harder to follow this time because it’s weirdly interrutped by Stamets going “maybe I was wrong to want to kill Zora”

The vote happens and it’s like 60% first contact 40% genocide. Book gets pissy and walks away without even talking to his girlfriend about it. What the fuck?

The only real takeaway I have about all this episode is that Cronenberg is based.

Oh let’s write out MORE interesting characters! Gray is leaving. THankfully Adira is NOT being written out just yet. But Gray is retiring to Trill. Ah well.

Aaaaand Book and his new obviously evil scientist friend steal the prototype Spore Drive, install it in his ship, and blast off to genocide some aliens with nukes. Book leaves his cat behind, which leaves ONE good joke, as Michael enters her room and finds Grudge.

“Zora, can you please find- Grudge?!” “Grudge is 5 meters from your current location.”

Anyways the Zora stuff was…. ok. Everything else I don’t really care. Why are they writing out all the good characters btw?

Stormy Weather - DIS 6.5/10

Hey, at least Owo is super hot

The president is how “how the FUCK did you not know Book would do this” and like, I didn’t know. I don’t know why he did!! He was struggling yeah, but he was getting better literally every episode. Going from “my loved ones who died still live through me, and it gets better every day” and then suddenly going “yeah let’s do genocide that might damage all of subspace” like an episode later is a bit of a fucking jump!!

YOU ARE THE VERY SPECIAL BOY, MICHAEL.

Michael gets the go ahead that she can do literally whatever she wants to get this taken care of. She assumes she knows where Book is gonna go to get the elements needed to make a bomb, literally Isolinium.

Where he’s going is to a broker. This super alien lookin’ mother fucker who no deals Book about nukes, turns out they areExpensive To Make, but agrees when Book basically offers to break some people betting heavy handed in his casino. Michael gets a bit late and finds out Book is already there, and now she has to outbid him in order to get the Isolinium before him. She TRIES talking to Book to tells her to go away. So they need to get like, 3x the latinum. How are they gonna do that?

Sexy fighter Owo.

She immediately gets her ass handed to her. Then fights again… loses again. So is she sandbagging? Yes, hardcore sandbagging. The people who got hustled get angry and and try to kill them, and then Book and Michael team up and help each other with their problems for some reason? The broker decides it’s a draw and they’re gonna decide who gets the nukes through a game of poker.

Michael and Book are still kind of working together here, because the other two people who could get the Isolynium are Emerald Chain warmongers and yeah they should not get a nuke. They work to knock the two out, and then are playing poker against each other. I do wish this was like, hardcore poker episode like something like Akagi but instead it’s a bit of a montage.

“If you take that Isolynium, you’ll burn every bridge you have.” “Does that include between you and me?” Yes, Book. Committing genocide does mean we’re breaking up. Obviously.

Booker wins, and leaves. Well done Book, I guess. Fuck you. But Michael knew she was probably going to lose, Book is good at Poker and she isn’t. So instead, she snuck a tracker into the isolynium. Also from the data we got about where the aliens are from, which we ALSO got from the Broker (it was the on the books reason we went). At the coordinates is some kind of weird thing that must be upkept with a LOT of energy, which Michael takes one look at and determines it runs on Boronite, and they realize they’re mining Boronite with the DMA.

Okay so I’ve obviously really not liked any episode in this season… except for this one. Finally, a good one. It was actualyl good! Not GREAT! But entertaining, I wasn’t BORED.

entry.title: LizstarTrek - Discovery Season 4 episodes 1 - 4
entry.content:
Every Sunday my Twitch subs and I watch Star Trek in my Discord. Here are my reviews and thoughts on each of the episodes as I see it. If you’re curious about a nerd’s views on Star Trek episodes, please read on, I go quite in depth with some of these episodes! I’ve watched some Star Trek before but not all of it!

I know literally nothing about Discovery, except for The Burn, and that it leads into Strange New Worlds. So uh… I’ve been dreading this one. But hey, who knows! Maybe it’ll surprise me!!

It has not so far. Y’all ready to see Michael save the universe again???

Kobayashi Maru - DIS 1.5/10

The title serves two purposes. One: Clap, nerds. Two: We already know we’re gonna be put in an unwinnable scenario, so it’s also a spoiler!

Captain Burnham and her boyfriend are now leading first contact re-communication with old Federation worlds. Why Burnham brought her boyfriend on away missions like this I do not know. Why she’s doing it herself, I also do not know. Why they are dressed in evil black leather instead of Federation outfits, I ESPECIALLY do not know. Seriously, what in the fuck? Anyways they were incompetent, of course. They piss off the people they’re there to offer help and services to and then have to run after the natives open fire. The two of them are now on the service, stranded, and trying to escape. We then have the people back on the ship trying to come up with some way to extract them and keep them safe. This is the most JJ Trek scene in this entire series, despite it being born of JJ Trek.

The people shooting at them only stop because their giant ship uncloaks in front of them. Then they give the natives some dilithium and leave. Uh, mission… accomplished??? This is already not looking good.

We get a scene with Saru on Kaminar saying it’s the start of a new era. Wow, I actually expected them to fully write him out of the show, I’m stunned he’s still here.

We’re just jumping around to a dozen scenes, aren’t we? Book is leaving for a while, and I guess Michael is now speaking to a bunch of ensigns. She is not happy to introduce the next Federation president, who appears to be part Cardassian. Michael appears to hate her, and I’m certain its NOT because she’s part Cardassian, you fucking racist, WE DIDN’T EVEN KNOW THE CARDASSIANS THAT WELL WHEN YOU WERE BORN. She claims it’s cause she hates politics and she thinks she’s just promoting herself or something, I dunno. It’s kinda boring. Anyways she’s joining them for a new mission that immediately goes wrong. They go to visit a space station and it’s careening around like it got punched out of orbit

For some reason when they go to black alert and jump it now makes as squeaky little noise. It feels like something a Youtube Poop would do. Someone in my chat described it as the noise a teletubby in a blender would make.

Book goes to his nephew’s bar mitzvah and this kid is like “I sure do love being alive!” Then he runs forward and it turns to slow motion. This kid is fucking dead.

Things start exploding cause some ice hits the ship or something and Michael immediately volunteers herself to go out and do some dangerous stunt to save the day. The president is like “what the fuck are you doing” while everyone on the bridge awkwardly looks at each other like the kids at the dinner table while the parents are fighting and getting divorced in front of them.

Why are we building these worker bees out of glass? Shit immediately breaks and she has to dip out of the worker bee. Why would you build it like that? The president actually uses her political knowhow and communication skills to talk down someone who’s about to shoot Tilly, which I guess gives her a reason to be here. All the while fires keep popping up behind them. Can we stop the hibachi grills back there please??

Wow, Kweijan fucking explodes and only Booker survives because he had bad vibes and was flying in his ship above the planet scanning it as it explodes. Anomaly - DIS 2/10

Book is not having a good time. Come on dog, your planet blew up, it’s not a big- oh wait yeah no that’s a realistic reaction. He’s just sat quietly staring at it for two days.

Saru shows up. He was offered captaincy of the new ship mentioned last episode but he turned it down…. to instead by Michael’s XO. I…. what the fuck??? Like I still want Saru on the show, I like him, but why are we doing this to him, HE SHOULD BE THE CAPTAIN. He basically got demoted for no reason. Also poor Tilly is even MORE demoted.

They have a security briefing where they determine it was a spacial anomaly possibly cause of two black holes colliding and they need to go look at it. Book walks in on this top priority meeting at Starfleet HQ. “Um, sir, you can’t go in there, that’s classified-“ “My planet blew up.” “Oh, well my apologies, go right ahead.”

We cannot let this series happen without a galactic threat.

We get a scene where Book wants to go risk his life flying into the black holes to study why they killed his family. Michael refuses to let him go and he throws a hissy fit and is like “YOU AREN’T THE BOSS OF ME DAD, I’M NOT EVEN STARFLEET, I’LL DO WHAT I WANT”

And then we get a scene with Gray seeing his new body he’s going to be put into. This series has a tone problem.

Book goes out on this mission but they get Stamets to hologram himself there so he can scan for the anomaly. Book is a shitty asshole about all of this. He’s grumpy and mean to Stamets who is awkward but trying his best. Book look I know you’re unhappy, understandably, but it’s not Stamets fault???

Some anomalies cause the ship to break and they need to release the tether holding Books ship. He has no sensors and is flying blind but they need that data, or whatever. Man I have Big Problem fatigue with this series. Stamets and Book have a talk. Apparently they’ve not been talking, because Stamets has been obviously avoiding him, cause Book reminds Stamets of how he couldn’t save his family at the end of season 3 and he doesn’t wanna be reminded of that. Understandable. But he’s at least TRYING now, So

Book: “No one is here for me. I am alone on this ship”

No, your cat is still on that ship for some fucking reason. Why you didn’t put her on the Discovery I will never know.

Michael has a heart to heart with Book about how their decks aren’t his fault. They do this by casting Cone of Silence around the captain’s chair, bringing up a fucking force field so she can talk to him without anyone overhearing. What the fuck?

Then they zoom out with a scary choral song playing. I mean… this is basically on the same level as the Chrystalline Entity, I dunno if we really need that.

Choose to Live - DIS 2/10

We open with Starfleet delivering some dilithium to some planet. Suddenly they’re under attack by some people in cloaks who attack with swords and kill the captain. She also says “Choose to live” so we know what she is. Gotta have MORE Qowat Milat.

They need to work with Nivar and the Qowat Milat to bring this murderer to justice, because she’s rogue. And also because they need Nivar to rejoin the Federation and so they need to do this without any problems. And they choose BURNHAM TO BE THE FEDERATION’S LIAZON IN THIS SITUATION. OF COURSE.

There’s been some mild hints at a plot line with Tilly suffering from PTSD and not being able to feel joy like she used to. She’s trying to get help for it, but the way the actress is, still so bubbly, it makes it even MORE sad, cause it’s clear she’s faking it.

Anyways they kill one of the other Qiwot Milot they have, and then go “do not follow or I will kill the rest of you”. Michael then Marvel Quips about it because we live in a Hell.

This nun took up their cause and is getting dilithium so that she can wake it up and deliver them to their new home. She didn’t want anyone finding out they existed so she did it all secretly. Why are you being a fucking baby about this. You’re a captain, you know how this shit works. “His family deserves justice!!!” They’re getting it! You just want to kill someone?

They also succeed in transferring Gray to a new body, he’s in a robo-body now, yay!

All of these are bad so far, god damn. The Stamets and Book stuff was okay?
